description: Output of the build role: what was implemented and where it departed from the plan.

summary.description: What you implemented and how you proved it: the files changed, the tests added, the proof commands and checks you ran and their result.

deviations.description: Every departure from the plan, one entry each. Empty array when you followed the plan exactly. Each deviation must also be written into plan.md in this same pass.

items.description: One deviation: what the plan said, what you did instead, and why.
